name: CCXP MX
blurb: The Mexican edition of Brazil's CCXP (Comic Con Experience), at Centro Citibanamex with panels, exhibitors, an Artists' Valley and board games.

editions.evidence: Official homepage (post-2026 recap page): 'Nos vemos nuevamente del 30 abril al 2 de mayo de 2027.' Corroborated by omelete.com.mx (the organizer's own media outlet): 'CCXPMX27 se llevará a cabo los días 30 de abril, 1 y 2 de mayo' at 'Centro Banamex' — the same article notes guests and panels 'se revelarán más adelante' (will be revealed later).

notes: The site currently shows a 'relive the best moments' recap of the just-finished CCXPMX26, with the 2027 dates already announced on that same page; no guests are named yet for 2027 (the organizer's own article explicitly says the lineup comes later), so guests is none-yet. Organizer is the legal entity from the site's own footer trademark notice ('CCXP® es una marca registrada de CCXP EVENTOS LTDA.'); Omelete (from the seed note) is the Brazilian media company behind the CCXP brand.
